# rails_apps_composer

**Tag**: web, template

## 简介

A gem with recipes to create Rails application templates you can use to generate Rails starter apps.

## 官网

- 主页: http://github.com/RailsApps/rails_apps_composer
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/rails_apps_composer/3.1.36
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/rails_apps_composer
